seo_title: Green Glazed French Khaprail Roof Tiles
meta_description: Green glazed khaprail tiles in a French interlocking profile for villas, feature roofs and boundary wall tops. See the glaze in person, free sample.
description:
These green glazed khaprail tiles are French-profile clay roof tiles with a green glaze, made by Pak Clay in Lahore for villas, feature roofs and boundary wall copings where a coloured roof is wanted.

## How they look
The French profile has raised ribs and channels that interlock with the next tile, so the finished roof reads as neat, even rows. The glaze gives the fired clay a green, slightly reflective surface, which stands out against the natural red of most Pakistani roofs. Glazed roof tiles tend to look different in shade and in full sun, so judge the colour outdoors.

## Where they work
- **Villa and farmhouse roofs** that want a distinctive colour.
- **Gazebos, porches and canopies**, where green roof tiles can tie into a garden.
- **Boundary wall tops and gate pillars** as a coloured cap.

A glaze is fired onto the clay, so the colour typically lasts without repainting, and the interlocking French profile khaprail shape is designed to channel rain down the roof.

## Good to know
- Material: fired clay with a green glaze
- Profile: French (interlocking)
- Category: khaprail roof tiles
- Size, coverage per square foot and matching ridge pieces: confirm on enquiry

Have your roofer confirm the slope, battens and underlay for your roof before ordering, and read [how khaprail tiles are installed](/blog/how-khaprail-roof-tiles-are-installed-slope-battens-and-overlap). Our guide to [khaprail colours](/blog/khaprail-tiles-colors-natural-red-glazed-green-and-more) compares glazed and natural finishes.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to check the green glaze in daylight, then send your roof area and city for a dated quote. Compare the [French natural red khaprail tile](/products/french-natural-red-khaprail-tiles) or browse all [khaprail tiles](/categories/khaprail-tiles).
ai_summary: Pak Clay's French green glazed khaprail tile is a fired clay roof tile with an interlocking French profile and a green glaze, made in Lahore. It suits villas, feature roofs and wall copings, with free samples on WhatsApp and showrooms in Lahore and Islamabad.

faqs.q: What is the price of green glazed khaprail tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the roof area, ridge and trim pieces, quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Does the green glaze fade in the sun?
faqs.a: A glaze is fused to the clay during firing, so it typically holds its colour far better than paint. Shade can still vary a little between batches, so order the full quantity together and check a sample outdoors.

faqs.q: Glazed or natural red khaprail: which should I choose?
faqs.a: Glazed tiles give a coloured, slightly shiny finish that stands out; natural red clay gives the traditional matt terracotta look and tends to weather softly. Both come in the French profile, so compare samples side by side.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "French Green Glazed Khaprail" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
